name: Tourism Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Per Angola's Migration and Foreigners Service (SME), the Tourism Visa is issued for recreational, sporting, or cultural visits. It must be used within 60 days of issuance, allows multiple entries, and permits stays of up to 30 days (extendable once). It explicitly prohibits taking up residence or paid employment. Required: passport valid at least 1 year with 4+ blank pages, a recent passport photo, and visa-specific supporting documents.
requirements.fix_path: Apply through an Angolan consulate or the SME with the standard passport and photo requirements, for recreational/sporting/cultural purposes only.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid 1+ year with 4+ blank pages

outcome.duration_length: 30 days per entry, extendable once; visa usable within 60 days of issuance

sources.title: Serviço de Migração e Estrangeiros (SME, Angola's migration authority) -- official visa category FAQ, including the Tourism Visa's purpose restriction, validity, and general document requirements
